status: Sealed from the independent v2.7.4 acceptance review before the v2.7.5 rule remediation.

provenance.authoring: Cases are direct reproductions or same-family counterexamples from the independent review of commit 5f680665.
provenance.sequencing: Expectations were frozen before editing the v2.7.4 classifier. A failing rule must be repaired without changing these expectations.
provenance.influence: This is pre-implementation regression evidence for the v2.7.5 remediation, not an estimate of population precision.
provenance.holdout: No source-level precision claim is made from this fixture. It covers known review failures and retained positive mechanisms.

reviewStandard: Every negative control abstains. Every positive states a connected relational mechanism. Primary, secondary, reason, and abstention are compared exactly.
